title.es: Presentamos The Forever Files: Wowhead's Forever Newsletter

summary.en: Introducing The Forever Files: Wowhead's Forever Newsletter...
summary.es: Presentamos The Forever Files: Wowhead's Forever Newsletter...

contentHtml:
Forever is Here to Stay!


With the launch of Forever, Wowhead is launching another newsletter! Introducing The Forever Files, ready to bring you the latest stats, info, and more right in your inbox.

We've got even more exciting news about The Pandaren Post. Now that Forever is here, Classic is taking a broader lens - so we're revamping that newsletter into Classic Chronicles, focused on all things Classic (minus Forever).


Everyone has been buzzing about Forever, and we have been too! We're looking to take a fresh angle on this new newsletter, focusing on statistics, burning questions, and even looking for your feedback with interactive polls. Forever is a brand new (but oh-so-familiar) world to explore, and we'll be right there with you, discovering as we go.

With weekly newsletters, you'll never have to sort through the dozens of breaking news posts in your feed again. We'll give you all the highlights of the most important events, discoveries, and tips & tricks of the week in one neat package delivered to your email automatically. Relax, kick back, and get ready for your weekends of playtime with all the news you'll need at your fingertips.

I'm in - Where do I sign up?

Signing up is easy - whether you want to subscribe to one, two, or all three of our regular email newsletters, all you need to do is head to your User Account Settings and select whichever Newsletters interest you under General Options. You'll also see links across our site to take you there quickly - just check the bottom of any News article for a fast way to find the spot you need!

Sign Up for Wowhead Weekly Newsletters here!


With several newsletters to choose from, players can customize their options - whether you're interested in one, two, or all three, it's easy to sign up, and you'll receive a welcome email shortly after.

Wowhead Weekly

Your source for everything Retail - from live game updates to PTR datamining and more, curated for the biggest news of the week.

Classic Chronicles

Era, Anniversary, SoD - Classic has enough flavors to make you dizzy. Any time there's Classic news, we have all the info you need to dive back in.

The Forever Files

Brand-new and here Forever - starting November 6, we'll be bringing you the latest stats, info, answers, interactive polls, and more.

Once you're signed up, all you have to do is sit back and relax - newsletters arrive Friday mornings, and the first issue of The Forever Files arrives on November 6th!

What are you waiting for? Come blast off with us!

title.en: Did Blizzard Tease Future WoW: Forever Class and Race Combinations?
title.es: ¿Blizzard se burló de las futuras combinaciones de clase y raza de WoW: Forever?

summary.en: Did Blizzard Tease Future WoW: Forever Class and Race Combinations?...
summary.es: ¿Blizzard se burló de las futuras combinaciones de WoW: Forever Class y Race?...

contentHtml:
Blizzard recently released a 30-minute Launch Overview video on the official World of Warcraft YouTube channel that gave a quick rundown of the new content and features coming in Forever, with an exclusive first look at some of the new dungeons and raid content.

However, people were quick to notice that some things were a bit off, as Chaos Bolts and other things that are not currently in the game were teased in certain shots.



That was not the only strange thing that was spotted. In several frames, a Druid could be seen using Starfall, an iconic ability from Wrath of the Lich King. Odd race combinations also made an appearance, like a Skyborne Paladin, a Tauren Mage casting Frostbolt, and a Night Elf rocking the Shaman tier 0.5 set.
Could these be teasers of what's to come or relics of things already far gone? It's likely the latter, but it serves as an interesting window into what the design philosophy may have been when developing Forever.

It's very possible that these spells and race combinations were things that were metaphorically thrown at the wall, but didn't stick. WoW trailers have been known to "reveal" things that never come to pass, with creative license and rule of cool taking over to advertise the game.

Or who knows - perhaps a Grimoire of Forbidden Chaos Magic hides somewhere in the world to be discovered by daring Destruction Warlocks. We'll find out soon enough!

summary.en: Every Guide You'll Need for Launch: the WoW: Forever Guide Compendium...
summary.es: Todas las guías que necesitarás para el lanzamiento: el WoW: Forever Guide Compendium...

contentHtml:
WoW: Forever launches today, and Wowhead's guides are now live! Learn everything you need to know about class changes, zones and systems, professions, dungeons, and more, all in one place.

In just a few short hours, at 3 pm PST, WoW: Forever launches - and players will jump straight into queues to hopefully make it into Azeroth quickly! Pick your class, settle in, and take a look at our guides for everything you need to survive through launch and beyond.

What Class Should You Play in WoW: Forever?

Haven't decided what to play yet? Don't worry - we have forever to figure it out. Between the last iterations of Classic, the beta, and recent updates, though, there's plenty to look at before you make your final decision. Looking to see what the talent trees look like now? Check out our Talent Calculator - but if you want to see all the changes a class has undergone, check out our Changes tool, where you can compare the most recent build to previous builds of Forever and Anniversary.

Forever Talent Calculator Class Changes Tool Class & Race Combinations in Forever


Still need some help deciding? Our Tier Lists have the details you'll need based on the beta to help you choose. We'll update these as players get closer to level 60 and the endgame!

Tank Tier List Healer Tier List DPS Tier List


Chosen your class and spec? We've got you covered - take a look at our class guides, which will receive updates as players progress to get you the best recommendations for talents, rotation, BiS, stat priority, and more.

Balance DruidFeral DruidFeral Tank DruidRestoration DruidBeast Mastery HunterMarksmanship HunterSurvival HunterArcane MageFire MageFrost MageHoly PaladinProtection PaladinRetribution PaladinDiscipline PriestHoly PriestShadow PriestAssassination RogueCombat RogueSubtlety RogueElemental ShamanEnhance ShamanRestoration ShamanAffliction WarlockDemonology WarlockDestruction WarlockArms WarriorFury WarriorProtection Warrior

What's New In WoW: Forever?

Classic players will certainly feel right at home, but Forever isn't just a cut-and-paste Anniversary server. Tons of new content has already been seen throughout the beta, and that was only until level 30! Plenty more is to come, and release is just the beginning. The Forever Roadmap lays out what Blizzard has in store for us, and even though Phase 1 is packed, the future of Forever looks bright.

Forever Phase 1 Guide Forever Content Roadmap


Plenty of new systems are available right on launch, though. Between Camping, Legacy Points, UI customization, and more, players will have a fresh twist on Classic that should let Forever last.

New and Changed Zones in Forever Camping Overview Legacy System in Forever How to Set Up Your UI


Choosing a WoW: Forever Profession

You've got your character, you know about the new systems - but have you decided on a profession yet? Every profession has gotten some changes, so whether you're a Gathering pro or a Crafting goblin, there's something new for you to check out in our Profession Overview.

Forever Professions Overview Profession Pairings by Class


Know what you're looking for? In that case, you'll need to level - and we've got the tool for you. Our brand-new Forever Profession Leveling Tool is ready to bring you straight to 300, no matter which Profession you choose. Stick to tried-and-true methods, or customize the leveling path depending on your skill; the choice is yours!

Alchemy Leveling Guide Blacksmithing Leveling Guide Enchanting Leveling Guide Engineering Leveling Guide Leatherworking Leveling Guide Tailoring Leveling Guide Cooking Leveling Guide First Aid Leveling Guide


Dungeons in WoW: Forever

Before Raids release, players will want to dive into Dungeons - and there's plenty, both old and new, to explore. We've only seen a few new instances in beta, but with players able to progress past level 30, we're sure everyone will be eager to jump into new content by the weekend - stick around for new guides as we jump right in!

Forever Dungeon Overview Every Known Dungeon Quest Tarnished Undermine Reals


Ragefire Chasm

One of the first dungeons Horde players likely enter, deep in the heart of Orgrimmar.
Ragefire Chasm Guide
The Hall of Thanes

Brand-new to Forever, an Alliance counterpart to Horde's Ragefire Chasm - head to Ironforge to try it out!
Hall of Thanes Guide
Wailing Caverns

Everyone's favorite early dungeon to get lost in - Druids can find a slithery surprise if they complete this dungeon's unofficial set.
Wailing Caverns Guide
The Deadmines

The Defias are plotting, but it's not too late to stop them - Alliance players in particular will have lots of quests here, but Horde Paladins will also need to dip in!
Deadmines Guide
Ruins of Lordaeron

Another brand-new dungeon; both Horde and Alliance players have some quests here, so it's worth the trip!
Ruins of Lordaeron Guide
Shadowfang Keep

If you want to summon the secret boss in another new Forever dungeon, you'll need to run this one - get ready to look for the Black Tome!
Shadowfang Keep Guide
Blackfathom Deeps

Not much has changed in this iconic dungeon on the coast of Ashenvale, but players will still likely jump in for quest experience on their leveling journey.
Blackfathom Deeps Guide
Excavation Site: Wetlands

The first new dungeon in this level bracket, Alliance has more quests here than Horde - but everyone has a shot at that sweet loot.
Excavation Wetlands Guide
Razorfen Kraul

First of two Razorfen dungeons, players will be able to jump right in at the southern part of the Barrens at the upper end of the 20-30 bracket.
Razorfen Kraul Guide
The Stockade

Deep in the heart of Stormwind, Horde players won't find any quests here - but if you're looking for a bit of PvP on your way to a dungeon, this is the one for you.
The Stockade Guide
Gnomeregan

Get ready to take a leap of faith (and hope that the Hunters dismissed their pets). Gnomeregan is notorious for a reason!
Gnomeregan Guide
City of Dalaran

Another brand-new dungeon, City of Dalaran is much easier to get to if you're Alliance, but Horde players can attune to it as well. Both factions can summon a sneaky secret boss, too - but only if you've run SFK and gotten the prerequisite item.
City of Dalaran Guide
Scarlet Monastery Graveyard

The entry-level Scarlet Monastery dungeon, Graveyard is still the same zone you know and love. Watch out for the Anguished Dead!
SM Graveyard Guide
Scarlet Monastery Library

SM Library might be a short wing, but that just means you get the loot faster. This is the last dungeon in the 20-30 bracket, and players will soon move on to the final two wings of Scarlet Monastery and beyond.
SM Library Guide
There are several new dungeons in this bracket that players haven't been able to test yet. When we can finally experience The Drowned City, Krol'dok Stronghold, Alcaz Prison, Shaper's Terrace, and Blackmaw Hold, we'll have dungeon guides available - until then, we've got our Classic dungeon guides ready to go!

Scarlet Monastery Armory

Only one boss lives in SM Armory, but you can try your luck at getting a Tabard of the Scarlet Crusade from the trash here as well. Who knows, there might be some secrets to find!
SM Armory Guide
Scarlet Monastery Cathedral

The final wing of Scarlet Monastery is where Sally Whitemane waits - take her on, take her down, and take home her loot.
SM Cathedral Guide
Razorfen Downs

The second Razorfen dungeon, RFD brings a significantly darker tone - both factions will be facing undead and completing quests on their way past level 40.
Razorfen Downs Guide
Upper Blackrock Spire

One half of a massive dungeon, Upper Blackrock Spire will take a bit for players to get to. Once they do, however, there's a solid chance of new content - we'll have to see what secrets wait in Blackrock Mountain.
UBRS Guide
Lower Blackrock Spire

The other half of the first Blackrock Mountain dungeon, Lower Blackrock Spire will pit players against Ogres, Trolls, and more in one of the longest dungeons in Classic WoW.
LBRS Guide
Scholomance

Class is in session! Face off against Darkmaster Gandling, earn Scourgestones, and maybe win a few rolls on BoEs if you're lucky.
Scholomance Guide
Uldaman

Pendulum of Doom, anyone? Take on Uldaman in the Badlands and learn more about the Titans while snagging some upgrades.
Uldaman Guide
Zul'Farrak

Trolls, Trolls, and more Trolls - you'll be sick of sand by the time you're through with this dungeon in Tanaris.
Zul'Farrak Guide
Maraudon

There are several different wings to work your way through in Maraudon, and the challenge progresses as you go. At the end, Princess Theradras waits with plenty of loot to snag, if you can bring her down.
Maraudon Guide

summary.en: Wowhead's Forever Tools Now Live and Updated for Launch...
summary.es: Wowhead's Forever Tools ya está disponible y actualizado para su lanzamiento...

contentHtml:
While waiting for Forever, for what has actually felt like forever, the Wowhead site devs have been keeping busy creating a selection of tools to help you on your journey ahead through Azeroth. While you may have already seen these tools, we've been working on updating everything you'll need for launch, so take a look at the improvements and what you may have missed.
Table of Contents
  • World Map
  • Talent Calculator
  • Experience Calculator
  • Dungeon Journal
  • Profession Leveling

Forever World Map Tool

At first glance, the World Map tool may look slightly overwhelming. But after a bit of time to play, we can 'almost' guarantee you will love it as much as we do.

WoW: Forever World Map
  • Find Books, Trainers, and other points of interest
  • Route Planner lets you work out the best way to travel
  • Plan Gathering Routes
  • Mark your own pins & save them for next time
All features on the World Map are adjustable by your level. So, if you are planning to play at launch with your friends at a different starter area, you can use this tool right now to figure out the best way to meet them in advance and how long it will take you to get to them!





Forever Talent Calculator




While a Talent Calculator is nothing new, this time around it comes with a few neat touches. Not only can you plan your characters talents, but you can also see each classes racials, and a full look at the spellbook, to really help you plan things out.

As Blizzard pushes hotfixes and changes to servers, we update our Talent Calculator with the latest data, so you know you'll always be up to date. When those patch notes hit, we'll be hard at work getting things up to speed.





WoW: Forever Talent Calculator

Experience Calculator

Some people are driven by numbers and enjoy numerical goals. If you are one of those people, this is the tool for you. At points in your travels to 60, you are likely going to feel like you have a long way to go - but this tool can help you to focus on the smaller goals by letting you see just how many quests or kills you'll need until that next level.

WoW: Forever Experience Calculator


You can adjust the calculator to show your rested experience and the benefit of eating food as well - so no guessing!



Dungeon Journal

New tools are great, but sometimes you just want something familiar. Our Dungeon Journal is inspired by the in-game Dungeon Journal that many players may be familiar with.

You can find dungeons here with loot, quests & strategy. The great thing is, the loot area of the Dungeon is updated directly from our database, so you should always be able to find the most up-to-date information - as soon as players make the discovery, that is.

WoW: Forever Dungeon Journal


 

Profession Leveling Tool

There are few things more frustrating than going to level a profession, following a guide, then finding yourself blocked by an overpriced herb. That is why our devs have created this special, interactive guide to help you out.

WoW: Forever Profession Guides
  • Choose between a fixed guide created by our writers or an interactive version customised to you
  • Pick Materials to avoid
  • Select Alternatives to suit you
  • Import your shopping list in-game with Auctionator or TSM
  • More Features coming directly after launch....






These tools have been created to help you through launch and your initial leveling. We have more tools that will help you as you level, and we will be showcasing them soon, so stick around for even more updates!

title.en: When Does WoW: Forever Launch Globally?
title.es: ¿Cuándo se lanza WoW: Forever a nivel mundial?

summary.en: When Does WoW: Forever Launch Globally?...
summary.es: ¿Cuándo se lanza WoW: Forever a nivel mundial?...

contentHtml:
It's almost here - WoW: Forever launches today, so check out what time you'll need to log on in your time zone during this global release!



Blizzard has told us that there will be a long maintenance today, so players have to wait a while longer before we're all able to jump into Azeroth. The maintenance is projected to end directly at launch time, but as with any launch, it may be delayed.



If all goes according to plan, however, players will be able to log in and start playing at 3 PM PST on November 4. Based on your timezone, that could be late into the night:
  • EST: 6 PM November 4
  • BRT: 8 PM November 4
  • GMT: 11 PM November 4
  • CET: 12 AM November 5
  • SAST: 1 AM November 5
  • TRT: 2 AM November 5
  • GST: 3 AM November 5
  • CST: 7 AM November 5
  • KST: 8 AM November 5
  • AEDT: 10 AM November 5
Hopefully everyone gets enough sleep ahead of time, and the launch goes smoothly - players will be experiencing a true megaserver for the first time, so prepare to make friends!

title.en: Classic Shaman Discord Open Again After 13 Hours
title.es: Classic Chamán Discord vuelve a abrir después de 13 horas

summary.en: Classic Shaman Discord Open Again After 13 Hours...
summary.es: Classic Chamán Discord se abre de nuevo después de 13 horas...

contentHtml:
After almost 13 hours, the Classic Shaman Discord has reopened, allowing all players to chat in its channels once again.

Earlier today at around 1:37 AM PST, the Classic Shaman Discord closed down, preventing players from posting in any channels. Citing "how the developers are approaching all shaman specs in WoW Forever", they listed a list of design issues that they felt were against the fundamental design and class feel of Shamans.

As of 2:28 PM PST, after almost 13 hours, the Discord is open once again and players can chat there to prepare for the WoW: Forever launch.
Doors are open again. You didn't think we'd seriously close the Discord for Forever's launch did you?
WoW: Forever launches in just over 24 hours with no listed tuning changes since the Development notes yesterday.
